_note: Every line in the game (M8; DESIGN.md 'Dialogue system'): family talk, radio calls, creatures and cutscene captions. Fields: id; speaker (config.story.speakers); channel 'radio' (a call while Tom's out), 'face' (said in the room; heard as a radio call when Tom's away) or 'caption'; text ({name} fills in from the caller); when { night: [min, max], phase: [...], all: [flags], none: [flags] }; priority (higher first); on (an event that plays it); next (the line that follows it); repeatable (never marked heard; dropped, not queued, if the radio's busy); kind (the radio's rate-limit kind); urgent (cuts the radio's queue, with the alarm pips); script (plays from its trigger only while that script is live: config.story.liveScripts); cue (where the line will be triggered, for the session that wires it); cued (M9.2: played only by the system named in its cue, never picked by talking to the family); draft (M9.2: written by the session for Aaron to edit). New lines are written with each encounter, with Aaron (Session 11).

lines.text: Ma'am. I mend. And I am good with machines. Give me a roof and your scrap, and that fence, that truck and that dozer will be something to see.

lines.cue: Build queue item 7: the ute chase and the garage (encounters/UteChase.js); scaffolding draft
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: We're keeping him, right? Dad? We're keeping him.

lines.cue: Build queue item 7: the ute chase and the garage (encounters/UteChase.js); scaffolding draft: a nudge
lines.speaker: sheriff
lines.text: The truck, friend. Under the roof by the gate.

lines.cue: Talk to Junie once she is home (Session 26: the stairs and the place beyond (encounters/Stairs.js, PlaceBeyond.js); draft)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: It knew all our names. It still does. When it calls at night I put my hands over my ears. You should too.

lines.cue: After junieBack.face.junie.1 (Session 26: the stairs and the place beyond (encounters/Stairs.js, PlaceBeyond.js); draft)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The people in old clothes. Can we get them back too?

lines.cue: Talk to Ellen once Junie is home (Session 26: the stairs and the place beyond (encounters/Stairs.js, PlaceBeyond.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: She hasn't let go of Wyatt since you got back. Good. The account said mend the land and find the Keeper. Whatever the Keeper is, Tom, we need it. That thing's still out there.

lines.cue: Talk to Wyatt once Junie is home (Session 26: the stairs and the place beyond (encounters/Stairs.js, PlaceBeyond.js); draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Eleven people, a hundred years, and nobody came back. Then you went up and you did. I want to be like you when I'm older. Just so you know.

lines.cue: The siege, first sight (over the radio) (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Dad. Dad, there's a clown. He's throwing knives at them. He's... he's really good at it.

lines.cue: After milo.siege.wyatt (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom, whatever that is, it isn't on our side. Don't go near it.

lines.cue: The gates scene: Milo bounds to the cars (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: Hoo-hoo! A guest! A GUEST! Mind the cars, they bite!

lines.cue: The gates scene: the bow, then the beckon (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: Welcome, welcome, WELCOME! In you come! The show's about to start!

lines.cue: Tom inside the barn: Milo at his chalk line, beckoning him to the board (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: Up on the stage, up you get! On the X! Arms down, chin up, and hold very... very... still!

lines.cue: The act: the first knife (it lands by his right shoulder) (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: One!

lines.cue: The act: the second (his left shoulder) (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: Two!

lines.cue: The act: the third (just over his head) (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: And... THREE!

lines.cue: The act: Tom moved (or fired) (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: Oh-ho-ho! A flincher! We have a FLINCHER! From the top, from the top!

lines.cue: The act done: Milo breaks character for one line, in his own warm voice (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Three for three. You didn't flinch.

lines.cue: After milo.warm: straight back into character, and the calliope horn (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: Ta-daaaa! Hoo-hoo-hoo! A present for the brave! Toot toot!

lines.cue: Tom shot at him: he knocked it aside with a knife (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: I was in character!

lines.cue: After milo.character.1: then Tom is thrown out (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: I was IN CHARACTER! Do you know how long it takes to get into character? Do you? OUT! Out of my barn!

lines.cue: Tom back at the cars after being thrown out (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: Show's closed. For YOU.

lines.cue: Milo chatter while Tom is near (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: Hoo-hoo! Don't mind the dead, I tidied!

lines.cue: Milo chatter (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: No ticket? No ticket! Free tonight! Free every night!

lines.cue: Milo chatter (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: Mind the donkey. She doesn't forgive.

lines.cue: Milo chatter (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: Hup! Hup-hup! Do you like my shoes? They're for the show.

lines.cue: Milo chatter (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: clown
lines.text: The turkey's a critic. Don't take it personally. I do.

lines.cue: The morning after: Milo outside the barn as just a man, a tin mug held out (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Instant. Sorry.

lines.cue: After milo.morning.1 (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Show's at eight. Same as every night. Mind how you go out there.

lines.cue: After the act (over the radio) (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Three knives, Dad. THREE. That's the coolest thing I have ever seen in my life.

lines.cue: After milo.act.wyatt (Milo's barn (encounters/MiloBarn.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom. Never. Do that. Again.

lines.cue: The Caller from inside the second coach, in Amos Pruitt's voice (Session 27: the railway cutting (encounters/RailwayCutting.js); draft)
lines.speaker: amos
lines.text: Levi? Levi, it's Amos. I'm in the car. Come on back now, they're all waiting on us.

lines.cue: The Caller from up the bank once Tom's aboard the second coach, Amos again (Session 27: the railway cutting; draft)
lines.speaker: amos
lines.text: Not in there, brother. Up here. Come up the bank. Mama's up here with the lantern.

lines.cue: The Caller from up the bank, as Hattie Bell McCoy, once Tom's taken her doll (Session 27: the railway cutting; draft)
lines.speaker: hattie
lines.text: Mister? That's my Polly. Will you bring her up to me? I'm only up the bank.

lines.cue: The Caller as the dead come up out of the cutting: a man's voice, from the line (Session 27: the railway cutting; draft)
lines.speaker: amos
lines.text: There's room on the train. There's room for everybody.

lines.cue: Talk to Ellen once the engineer's note is handed in (Session 27: the railway cutting (encounters/RailwayCutting.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: They got on a train to get away from it, Tom. And it stopped them in the cut, with a lantern. It knew they were leaving.

lines.cue: Talk to Wyatt once the baggage checks are handed in (Session 27: the railway cutting (encounters/RailwayCutting.js); draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Every name on those stones had a ticket out, Dad. Charleston. They were nearly gone.

lines.cue: Talk to Ellen once Hattie Bell's doll is handed in, Junie still gone (Session 27: the railway cutting (encounters/RailwayCutting.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Put it somewhere I can't see it. Please. Not on her bunk.

lines.cue: Talk to Junie once Hattie Bell's doll is handed in, Junie home (Session 27: the railway cutting (encounters/RailwayCutting.js); draft)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: She's very old. Her name's Polly. I know because she told me.

lines.cue: Talk to Wyatt once the cowcatcher's handed in (Session 27: the railway cutting (encounters/RailwayCutting.js); draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: A cowcatcher! Bolt that on the dozer's blade, Dad, and nothing's stopping it. Nothing.

lines.cue: The recall message looping on the last agent's car radio, as Tom comes near the sedan (Session 28: the sawmill (encounters/Sawmill.js); draft)
lines.speaker: dispatch
lines.text: ...ground station is lost. All field units, hold your positions and wait for recall. Do not return to the Armory. This message repeats.

lines.cue: The car radio again as the dead agents get up (Session 28: the sawmill; draft)
lines.speaker: dispatch
lines.text: ...hold your positions and wait for recall. This message repeats.

lines.cue: Talk to Ellen once Harlan Stover's day book is handed in (Session 28: the sawmill (encounters/Sawmill.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: He worked it out, Tom. That last night he knew what was coming up the road, and he sent his men back to the saw anyway. I hope I'd have the nerve.

lines.cue: Talk to Wyatt once the head saw is handed in (Session 28: the sawmill (encounters/Sawmill.js); draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Sixty inches? Dad. Put that on the dozer's blade and it's not a dozer any more.

lines.cue: Talk to Ellen once Tom has the chainsaw (Session 28: the sawmill (encounters/Sawmill.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: That thing stays outside, Tom. And whatever's on it, you clean it off before the kids see.

lines.cue: Talk to Ellen once the Rigsbys' trap map is handed in (Session 29: the moonshiners' holler (encounters/Holler.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: They saw the lights and thought it was the law coming for their still. I keep thinking how close that is to right.

lines.cue: Talk to Wyatt once the still's copper worm is handed in (Session 29: the moonshiners' holler (encounters/Holler.js); draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: That's a heat exchanger, Dad. Run it the other way, pump the jugs through it, light the end. The dozer breathes fire. I'm not even joking.

lines.cue: Talk to Ellen once Tom has the auto shotgun (Session 29: the moonshiners' holler; draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Where did a family up a holler get a thing like that? No. Don't tell me. Just keep it pointed away from the house.

lines.cue: Over the radio once Tom's seen the headframe (the arrival sweep's end), where the radio reaches (Session 31: the abandoned mineshaft (encounters/Mineshaft.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Black Laurel? That's been shut since before I knew you. Bad air, they said. What does the army want with a dead coal mine?

lines.cue: Over the radio once Tom's counted the tags on the board (Session 31: the abandoned mineshaft (encounters/Mineshaft.js); draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Eleven tags still up? Dad, that's what the board's for. Eleven men went down and nobody came back for their tag.

lines.cue: Over the radio once the car battery's on the lift (Session 31: the abandoned mineshaft (encounters/Mineshaft.js); draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: You're running a mine hoist off a car battery. That's the best and the worst idea you've ever had.

lines.cue: Over the radio as the cage starts down the first time: it cuts her off (Session 31: the abandoned mineshaft (encounters/Mineshaft.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom, the second that cage drops we lose you. Whatever's down there, it isn't wor

lines.cue: Over the radio at the collar, the mine blown and sealed behind him (Session 31: the abandoned mineshaft (encounters/Mineshaft.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom! Tom, answer me. The whole house jumped. Tell me that was you.

lines.cue: Over the radio after Ellen's, at the collar (Session 31: the abandoned mineshaft (encounters/Mineshaft.js); draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Was that the mine? Dad. Did you blow up a mine?

lines.cue: The Caller over the radio at the collar, in Ellen's voice, where the family can't reach (the mine south of the comms line) (Session 31: the abandoned mineshaft (encounters/Mineshaft.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom. You left one of them down there. Go back down and get him.

lines.cue: Talk to Ellen once Everett Shaw's logbook is handed in (Session 31: the abandoned mineshaft (encounters/Mineshaft.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: It came up out of the ground, and they put it in a box and drove it past our road. And he left his tag in his locker so nobody would go down after him. I'm glad somebody read it, Tom.

lines.cue: Talk to Wyatt once the rock drill's head is handed in (Session 31: the abandoned mineshaft (encounters/Mineshaft.js); draft)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: That's off a drifter. It's made to chew into a mountain all shift and not care. Front of the dozer, Dad. Front and centre.

lines.cue: Talk to Ellen once the mine's sealed (Session 31: the abandoned mineshaft (encounters/Mineshaft.js); draft)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: So that's one door shut. I don't know how many there are. But that one's shut, and you shut it.

lines.cue: Talk to Junie once the mine's sealed, Junie home (Session 31: the abandoned mineshaft (encounters/Mineshaft.js); draft)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: You smell like a bonfire. Did the big moths get out? I hope the big moths got out.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'none' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: I'm still putting it together, Tom. Go on. I'll have more when you're back.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'tower' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Up the tower first, Tom. Every channel's static and I can't see a thing from in here. I need to know what's out in those trees.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'towerRifle' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: The rifle's still up on the tower where Wyatt left it. Bring it down with you. I don't want you out there with empty hands.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'campsite' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: The campers' fire went out in the night and nobody's answering. If they're hurt, we're the only help for forty miles. West trail, out the gate.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'search' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Go through their shelters, Tom. Anything that says what happened to them. Anything we can use.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'battery' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: The fence box is dead and it'll be dark by six. Their car's battery will run it. Bring it home.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'fit' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: That battery goes in the fence box, just inside the gate. A live wire is the only thing between us and whatever took those campers.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'repair' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: There's a panel down on the east side. One gap is all they'd need. Patch it before the light goes.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'junie' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Junie's been asking for you. Go and sit with her a minute before it gets dark. She saw more than she's saying.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'camera6' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Camera six caught something. Watch it, Tom. I want to know if you see what I saw.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'night1' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: They came out of the woods where she was kneeling. Hold the fence until dawn. That's all we have to do tonight.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'gasStation' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Earl Pruitt has watched those woods for thirty years, and nobody ever listened to him. If anyone knows what she is, it's Earl. South of the campground.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'gasInside' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Look for the Pruitts in the store, Tom. And look at how they left. People who run leave things behind.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'phone' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Try Earl's phone. If there's a line out of this county, I want to know it.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'scanner' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Earl's scanner is in his stockroom, behind the counter. It hears the army's channels. Mine doesn't.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'scannerBattery' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Earl's scanner hears the army's channels. Mine doesn't. Get it running, off a car battery if you have to.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'note' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Earl wouldn't leave Marcy without a word. Find what he wrote her.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'gasLook' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Have a look out front before you leave Earl's. Something was moving on the forecourt camera.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'shelter' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Earl's note said the shelter. It's up the track behind his store. If the Pruitts are anywhere, they're there.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'spade' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Take Earl's spade from beside his track. Whatever she's burying, we'll want it out of the ground.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'shelterSigil' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: That glowing thing by the hatch is the same as the one she buried here. Dig it up. I think it's what calls them.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'keys' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Earl kept his keys on him. The combination to his safe is on them. I'm sorry, Tom. I know what I'm asking.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'hatch' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: The hatch is under the dirt. Dig it out. Earl spent thirty years getting ready for this, and it's all down there.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'room' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Go down, Tom. His diary, his tapes. Earl saw her with his own eyes. I've only ever seen the paperwork.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'tapes' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Watch Earl's tape. Everything I pieced together from inside the facility, he filmed from a deer stand.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'safe' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Earl's safe is in the stockroom behind his counter, and you've got his combination. He kept the good rifle in it. We'll need it.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'night2Home' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Come home, Tom. She's seen you digging up her work, and she won't send a handful this time.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'night2Prep' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Battery in the fence box, scrap into the fence. Wyatt's taking Earl's rifle up the tower. Whatever comes tonight, we hold it at the wire.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'night2' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Hold the station. That's the whole plan. Dawn stops them. It stopped them last night.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'night2Screamer' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: That thing at the treeline is calling them in. Wyatt says it flinches when it's hit. Put it down and the rest will thin out.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'night2After' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Hold on, Tom. It's nearly light.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'outpostGate' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: The army had her and lost her. They need to know she's loose, and I need to know what else was on that convoy. Take the road past Earl's.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'farm' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: The main gate's shut and nobody's on it. The Pruitts' land backs onto the army's fence. Take the east track to their farm and find a way through.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'farmMoths' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Those moths go to light, Tom. Kill the porch light and they'll have nothing to come to. Earl's generator is round the side of the house.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'farmHouse' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Go through the Pruitts' house. Marcy kept a journal. I'd like to know what she believed.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'plot' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: She's been in the Pruitts' family plot. Camera eight saw her. Dig up whatever she left there before you go on.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'outpostRip' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Past the family plot there's a tear in the army's fence. Something went through it. So can you.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'outpost' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Get to the checkpoint, Tom. Tell them the witch is loose. And look at what they were guarding while you're there.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'outpostFight' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Their own dead are still at their posts. Clear them, and use what the soldiers left. The generator and that machine gun both run off a car battery.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'outpostPeak' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Hold their barricade, Tom. It held for them longer than anything else did.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'outpostCompound' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Go through the compound. Crates, containers, their comms hut. I want to know what was on that convoy, and what's still missing.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'cross' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: The checkpoint's open. Whatever came down in the south, the army was more afraid of it than of her. We need to know why.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'plane' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: A plane came down just past the checkpoint. If the pilot's alive, he saw what they were chasing.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'planeLoot' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Whatever that creature dropped, bring it home. I want to see what it's made of.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'planeCell' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: That cell from the plane puts out more than any battery we've got. Fit it to the fence box. I want the fence stronger before tonight.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'planeCellBack' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Go back to the plane, Tom. What that creature dropped could run the whole fence.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'radioHome' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Your radio's smashed. We couldn't reach you all night.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'junieClip' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: The south path camera. Watch it, Tom. Please.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'findJunie' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: She went south, past the plane, following your voice. It wasn't your voice. Find her, Tom. I'll hold here with Wyatt.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'churchLook' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: There's an old church on Earl's maps, south and west of the plane. Hemlock Gap. If this has happened before, somebody there wrote it down.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'capsuleRead' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Bring that account to the ledger and read it properly. A hundred years ago to the month, Tom. That's not chance.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'stairs' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Amos Pruitt's stairs, east of the church. The account says the children climbed to the voice. That's where she is.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'climb' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Take the silent way, every time. The voice will sound like me. It will sound like her. Don't answer it.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'junieHome' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Bring her home, Tom. Just bring her home.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'plan' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Sit down a minute. Wyatt and I have been talking, and you should hear it.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'earlMaps' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Earl's maps are on the corkboard down in his shelter. Thirty years of sightings. I want them up here beside mine.

lines.cue: Ellen at her string board, asked what's next on the step 'dozerFind' (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: The army's clearing crew left a dozer where the cordon stops, east of the checkpoint. It has a winch. We can use a winch.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The dead ones don't run, Dad. I counted on camera two. But they don't stop either.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: They fall down faster if you get them in the head. Wyatt said. I watched and he's right.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: When the fence is on they just stand at it and get hurt. They don't learn. Is that sad?

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: They come from where she buried it. Every time. If you dig it up before dark, the camera stays quiet.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: When it got light they all just went back in the ground. Mum wrote it down twice.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The big one at Mr Pruitt's had a soft bit on its back. I saw it glow on the forecourt camera. Hit it there.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The ones she leaves lying down aren't sleeping, Dad. They get up if you go too near. You can go round them.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The lady doesn't walk. I watched her on the camera and her feet don't move. I don't think you can shoot her.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The screaming one calls the others. But when Wyatt hit it, it went quiet for ages. Keep hitting it.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Wyatt can see the whole fence from the tower. He says shout if one gets behind you. He can't hear you, though.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Moths like the light. If your torch is on they come to you. If it's off they go to the next brightest thing.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The thing with the red eyes was on camera eight for one picture. Then it wasn't. It's really fast, Dad.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The soldier ones have helmets on. Wyatt says shoot them in the body, or wait till the helmet comes off.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Off the paths there are moths in the deep trees now. They find you after a while. Stay on the trails if you can.

lines.cue: Junie at the monitors, asked what she's seen (story/FamilyStations.js; Round 2, step 5)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The little grey one bled green on the camera. It was scared of you, I think. I don't think it wanted to be here.
